text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Tannhauser. Do you<n>have any
goals for the year ahead?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that I'm one step closer to<n>being an
adult, I want to be more<n>reliable!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Speaking of reliable, you forgot<n>you're
supposed to clean in front of<n>the school gate, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trusty Turbo covered for you! No<n>biggie, it's your
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me. This morning, you<n>left your
laundry in the dryer. I went<n>ahead and carried it to
your room.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oof... Guess I'm a long ways from<n>being reliable...
